This is just a list of all existing controls for the simulation. 
For now they can't be changed, but I'll be working on that at some point

WASD // Arrow keys => move the camera  
Page-up => increase camera scroll speed (x1.25)
Page-down => decrease camera scroll speed (x0.8)
Scroll-wheel => Zoom In/Out by small increment
Click-and-Dragging scroll-wheel => gradual zoom in/out
+ // Keypad+ => zoom in (x0.8)
- // Keypad- => zoom out (x1.25)
Home => return to (0,0)

R => select random bibite
E => select random egg
G => select bibite with highest gen count
O => select oldest bibite
Z => select random zone
K => autopanning mode (needs to be reworked)

LCtrl + [Any selection Key] => automatically reselect same type on target death

Space => toggle Pause/Play
H => toggle UI visibility
F5 => save the game under "quick.zip", overwriting any previous quicksave
F9 => load last quick save
Insert => Lay Egg of selected bibite
Delete => Kill selected bibite or egg
CTRL-dragging a bibite => Rotates bibite toward cursor
CTRL-click certain UI elements => developer mode (used for videos)
